entries.title: 虚空采矿场 I-III (Void Miner)
lines: 以下是气体消耗倍率，按 MK1 / MK2 / MK3 排列。
增产倍率仍为：氖 ×4、氪 ×8、氙 ×16、鿫 ×64。
气体不足时不扣气，机器按基础产量继续运行。
所需气体必须来自同一份存储，不能拼凑多个仓中的余量。
newMat: 氖、氪、氙或 鿫（增产气体）
linesEn: Gas cost multipliers below are ordered MK1 / MK2 / MK3.
Ore boosts remain x4 / x8 / x16 / x64 respectively.
Insufficient gas is not consumed; mining continues at baseline yield.
The payment must fit one stored fluid stack; separate hatches are not combined.
newMatEn: Neon, Krypton, Xenon or Oganesson boosters
summary: 三个档位都能用四种稀有气体增产。
气体消耗大幅增加，缺气时只按基础产量运行。
summaryEn: All three tiers accept all four noble-gas boosters.
Gas costs rise sharply. Insufficient gas gives unboosted output.
entries.heading: 虚空采矿气体

entries.title: 避雷针 HV/EV/IV
lines: 杆塔必须使用 GT 铁栅栏，顶端上方不能有遮挡。
每 256 tick 尝试落雷一次，约每 12.8 秒一次。
16 根栅栏时概率为 12.5%，32 根及以上为 25%。
提高控制器的海拔不会增加落雷概率。
每次成功落雷会随机破坏一根栅栏，需要补回。
HV / EV / IV 档位和 512 A 输出保持原样。
newMat: 至少 16 根 GT 铁栅栏
linesEn: The mast must use GT Iron Fences with clear air above its top.
A strike is attempted every 256 ticks, about 12.8 seconds.
Chance is 12.5% at 16 fences and capped at 25% at 32 or more.
Controller altitude gives no chance bonus.
Each successful strike destroys one random fence; replace it.
HV / EV / IV ratings and 512 A output are retained.
summary: 只在雷暴中发电，需要至少 16 根连续铁栅栏。
每次落雷充满 10,000,000 EU，并破坏一根栅栏。
summaryEn: Generates only in thunderstorms with at least 16 consecutive Iron Fences.
A strike fills 10,000,000 EU and destroys one fence.
entries.heading: 避雷针发电

entries.title: 质量发生器 单方块
lines: 单方块质量发生器会在开工前检查增幅器是否足够。
不消耗增幅器的 NEI 配方已移除。
linesEn: The singleblock Mass Fabricator checks for enough amplifier before starting.
The unamplified NEI recipe is removed.
summary: 生产 UU 物质必须消耗 UU 增幅器。
只供电、不放增幅器，机器不会生产。
summaryEn: UU-Matter production requires UU-Amplifier.
Power alone no longer starts a batch.
entries.heading: UU 物质生产

entries.title: 物质发生器CPU
lines: 物质发生器 CPU 仍可使用消耗 UU 增幅器的路线。
linesEn: Matter Fabrication CPU retains the routes that consume UU-Amplifier.
summary: 两条不消耗增幅器的 UU 物质配方已移除。
summaryEn: Both unamplified UU-Matter recipes are removed.
entries.heading: 物质发生器 CPU

entries.title: 流体提取机
lines: 移除的是这两种植物的 UU 物质提取路线。
UUA Berry 等增幅器原料的生产路线仍保留。
linesEn: The two plant-to-UU-Matter extraction routes are removed.
UUA Berry and other amplifier-production routes remain available.
summary: 不能再从 UU-Matter Berry 或 Space Flower 提取 UU 物质。
summaryEn: UU-Matter Berry and Space Flower no longer yield UU-Matter.
entries.heading: 植物提取 UU 物质

entries.title: 冷却塔
lines: 每批输入 9,000 mB 热四氧化钌溶液。
产出 7,200 mB 四氧化钌、1,800 mB 水和 6 份盐粉。
需要能源仓和输出总线；输出堵塞时不会扣料开工。
原有蒸汽冷凝仍无需供电，按 160:1 转换。
linesEn: Each batch uses 9,000 mB Hot Ruthenium Tetroxide Solution.
Outputs: 7,200 mB Ruthenium Tetroxide, 1,800 mB Water and 6 Salt Dust.
An Energy Hatch and Output Bus are needed. Blocked output prevents consumption.
Passive Steam condensation remains unpowered at a 160:1 ratio.
summary: 热四氧化钌溶液现在改由冷却塔分离。
这条配方需要 HV 供电，耗时 75 秒。
summaryEn: Hot Ruthenium Tetroxide Solution is now separated here.
This recipe needs HV power and takes 75 seconds.
entries.heading: 冷却塔分离

entries.title: 蒸馏塔
lines: 冷却塔的新分离配方需要 HV 供电，耗时 75 秒。
絮凝废液不能再蒸馏回收铝、氧气和盐酸。
linesEn: The relocated Coolant Tower recipe runs at HV for 75 seconds.
Flocculation Waste can no longer be distilled into Aluminium, Oxygen and Hydrochloric Acid.
summary: 热四氧化钌溶液的分离配方已移到冷却塔。
絮凝废液回收路线也已移除。
summaryEn: Ruthenium solution separation has moved to the Coolant Tower.
Flocculation Waste recovery is also removed.
entries.heading: 蒸馏塔配方

entries.title: 蒸馏室
lines: 轻油、中油和重油的输入量都翻倍。
润滑油产量仍分别为 3 / 6 / 9 mB，耗时和电压不变。
絮凝废液不能再回收铝、氧气和盐酸。
linesEn: Light Oil, Medium Oil and Heavy Oil inputs all double.
Lubricant outputs remain 3 / 6 / 9 mB, with the same duration and voltage.
Flocculation Waste no longer returns Aluminium, Oxygen or Hydrochloric Acid.
summary: 电路 24 的润滑油配方：油输入从 12 增至 24 mB。
絮凝废液回收路线已移除。
summaryEn: Circuit-24 Lubricant recipes use 24 mB oil instead of 12 mB.
Flocculation Waste recovery is removed.
entries.heading: 润滑油蒸馏

entries.title: 化学反应釜 部分配方
lines: 铟富集溶液处理：铝粉用量从 4 增至 8。
钠法制硅：盐粉副产物从 8 减至 7。
氢气制硅：盐酸副产物从 3,000 减至 2,000 mB。
BartWorks 锌法制硅：副产粉从 6 减至 5。
铂金属粉处理：氯化钙副产物从 3 减至 2。
皮米功率IC晶圆：纳米功率IC晶圆输入从 1 增至 64。
电路 8 钚衰变：钚粉产出从 64 减至 63。
脱磷钐精：钐粉概率从 90% 降至 5%。
大小钐混合物：钐粉概率为 10%。
林业铟路线：浓缩 3→2、磷酸盐 6→4、净化矿 12→8、硫铟铜矿 3→2。
硅岩提纯还需分级净化水，详见对应配方的图标对照。
linesEn: Indium concentrate: Aluminium Dust input rises from 4 to 8.
Sodium-to-Silicon: Salt Dust byproduct falls from 8 to 7.
Hydrogen-to-Silicon: Hydrochloric Acid output falls from 3,000 to 2,000 mB.
BartWorks Zinc-to-Silicon: secondary dust output falls from 6 to 5.
Raw Platinum processing: Calcium Chloride output falls from 3 to 2.
PPIC Wafer: NPIC Wafer input rises from 1 to 64.
Circuit-8 Plutonium decay: Plutonium Dust output falls from 64 to 63.
Dephosphated Samarium Concentrate: Samarium chance falls from 90% to 5%.
Small and large Samarium blends now have a 10% Samarium chance.
Forestry Indium routes: concentrate 3→2, phosphate 6→4, purified ore 12→8, Roquesite 3→2.
Naquadah purification also needs graded purified water; inspect the recipe cards.
summary: 部分配方增加耗料或减少副产物。
铟富集溶液处理用铝粉翻倍，皮米功率IC晶圆用 纳米功率IC晶圆增至 64。
summaryEn: Several recipes use more material or yield fewer byproducts.
Indium concentrate doubles Aluminium; PPIC Wafers need 64 NPIC Wafers.
entries.heading: 化学反应配方

entries.title: 大型化学反应釜 (LCR)
lines: 原来的完美超频已取消：每次超频，耗时变为 1/3，EU/t 变为 4 倍。
工作台和组装机配方均改用 EV 电路。
电路 10 的新钚衰变路线：额外用 800 mB 氦，产出 63 钚粉和 960 mB 氡。
铟富集溶液处理：铝粉用量从 4 增至 8。
钠法制硅：盐粉副产物从 8 减至 7。
氢气制硅：盐酸副产物从 3,000 减至 2,000 mB。
BartWorks 锌法制硅：副产粉从 6 减至 5。
铂金属粉处理：氯化钙副产物从 3 减至 2。
皮米功率IC晶圆：纳米功率IC晶圆输入从 1 增至 64。
电路 8 钚衰变：钚粉产出从 64 减至 63。
脱磷钐精：钐粉概率从 90% 降至 5%。
大小钐混合物：钐粉概率为 10%。
林业铟路线：浓缩 3→2、磷酸盐 6→4、净化矿 12→8、硫铟铜矿 3→2。
硅岩提纯还需分级净化水，详见对应配方的图标对照。
newMat: EV 电路（替代 HV 电路）
linesEn: Perfect overclocking is replaced: duration is divided by 3 and EU/t multiplied by 4 per overclock.
Both crafting and Assembler production use EV circuits.
New circuit-10 Plutonium decay uses an extra 800 mB Helium and yields 63 Plutonium Dust plus 960 mB Radon.
Indium concentrate: Aluminium Dust input rises from 4 to 8.
Sodium-to-Silicon: Salt Dust byproduct falls from 8 to 7.
Hydrogen-to-Silicon: Hydrochloric Acid output falls from 3,000 to 2,000 mB.
BartWorks Zinc-to-Silicon: secondary dust output falls from 6 to 5.
Raw Platinum processing: Calcium Chloride output falls from 3 to 2.
PPIC Wafer: NPIC Wafer input rises from 1 to 64.
Circuit-8 Plutonium decay: Plutonium Dust output falls from 64 to 63.
Dephosphated Samarium Concentrate: Samarium chance falls from 90% to 5%.
Small and large Samarium blends now have a 10% Samarium chance.
Forestry Indium routes: concentrate 3→2, phosphate 6→4, purified ore 12→8, Roquesite 3→2.
Naquadah purification also needs graded purified water; inspect the recipe cards.
summary: 每次超频：速度提高 3 倍，耗电提高 4 倍。
制造控制器时，HV 电路改为 EV 电路。
summaryEn: Each overclock gives 3x speed at 4x power draw.
Controller production now uses EV circuits instead of HV circuits.
entries.heading: 大型化学反应釜

entries.title: 工业高炉/EBF (工业高炉) 部分配方
lines: 铕晶棒：八种气体路线均额外消耗 2 份六氟化镎粉。
镅晶棒：只保留 鿫 路线，并额外消耗 2 份镤粉。
硅岩 / 富集硅岩 / 超能硅岩提纯：每批分别增加 1,000 mB 一级 / 二级 / 三级净化水。
制钛：氯化镁副产物从 6 减至 4。
钛铁矿：钛铁矿粉 5→10、碳粉 1→2，主要产物翻倍，另加 1 份矿渣；160→300 秒。
制钢：铁粉直接炼钢路线移除，改用铸铁粉；铸铁路线耗时 45 秒。
新增铸铁路线：3 铁粉 + 2 碳类粉，用电路 1，MV 20 秒。
铝：冰晶石路线 80→120 秒；氮气路线 60→90 秒；无气体路线 75→140 秒。
氧化铝直接还原及七种稀有气体炼铝路线已移除。
碎铅矿：铅锭概率为 100%，两粒碲粒的概率为 0.1%。
精炼铂盐：不再产出 87 mB 氯气。
linesEn: Europium Boule: all eight gas routes add 2 Neptunium Hexafluoride Dust.
Americium Boule: only Oganesson remains, with 2 extra Protactinium Dust.
Naquadah / Enriched Naquadah / Naquadria purification add 1,000 mB Grade 1 / 2 / 3 Water respectively.
Titanium: Magnesium Chloride byproduct falls from 6 to 4.
Ilmenite: dust 5→10, Carbon 1→2, main outputs double, plus 1 Slag; duration 160→300 seconds.
Direct Iron Dust steelmaking is removed. The Cast Iron route takes 45 seconds.
New Cast Iron route: 3 Iron Dust + 2 Carbon-family Dust, circuit 1, MV, 20 seconds.
Aluminium: Cryolite 80→120 seconds; Nitrogen 60→90; no-gas 75→140.
Direct Aluminium Oxide reduction and seven noble-gas smelting routes are removed.
Crushed Lead gives guaranteed Lead and a 0.1% chance of 2 Tellurium Nuggets.
Refined Platinum Salt no longer gives 87 mB Chlorine.
summary: 部分晶棒和硅岩提纯配方增加材料要求。
铝、钢和钛铁矿路线也有调整，详见配方图标。
summaryEn: Some boule and Naquadah recipes need extra materials.
Aluminium, Steel and Ilmenite routes also change; inspect their recipe cards.
entries.heading: 高炉配方

entries.title: 核聚变反应堆控制电脑 (Fusion Computer) MK1-MK5
lines: 铕、镅基础路线：每批输入 ×4，产出减为 1/4，因此单位耗料为原来的 16 倍。
使用钷的路线：输入和产出都减半，但耗时变为 4 倍。
只有老式 MK2–MK5 结构替换线圈位置，MK1 和紧凑型结构不变。
newMat: 电磁隔离机械方块（老式 MK2–MK5）
matchName: 核聚变反应堆控制电脑
linesEn: Base routes multiply inputs by 4 and divide output by 4: 16x material cost per unit.
Promethium routes halve both inputs and output but take 4x as long.
Americium Plasma ignition rises from 500,000,000 to 1,000,000,000 EU, requiring MK4.
Only legacy MK2–MK5 coil positions change. MK1 and Compact structures are unchanged.
summary: 铕和镅的基础聚变路线：单位产物耗料增加到 16 倍。
老式 MK2–MK5 的线圈位置改用电磁隔离机械方块。
summaryEn: Base Europium and Americium fusion costs 16x more material per unit.
Legacy MK2–MK5 coil positions need Electromagnetically-isolated Casings.
entries.heading: 聚变成本与结构

entries.title: 装配线
lines: 需要先用 AE2 空间存储系统创建空间世界。
截面为 3×4，最多 16 节；2×2×2 空间单元放不下。
16×16×16 空间可以容纳，仍需为连接部件留位置。
部件装配线和电路装配线不受这条限制。
linesEn: Create a Spatial Storage world with AE2 before building it.
Its cross section is 3×4 with up to 16 slices; a 2×2×2 cell is too small.
A 16×16×16 space fits it, with room still needed for connections.
Component and Circuit Assembly Lines are exempt.
summary: 装配线只能在 AE2 空间存储世界中成型。
主世界等其他维度无法使用。
summaryEn: This Assembly Line forms only inside AE2 Spatial Storage worlds.
It cannot operate in the Overworld or other dimensions.
entries.heading: 装配线建造维度

entries.title: 进阶装配线/GigaGramFab (进阶装配线)
lines: 限制与普通装配线相同，需要 AE2 创建的空间世界。
2×2×2 空间太小；使用能容纳结构和连接部件的空间单元。
linesEn: The same dimension restriction applies to GigaGramFab Advanced Assembly Line.
A 2×2×2 cell is too small; use space large enough for the structure and connections.
summary: 进阶装配线也只能在 AE2 空间存储世界中成型。
summaryEn: The Advanced Assembly Line also forms only in AE2 Spatial Storage worlds.
entries.heading: 进阶装配线建造维度

entries.title: 超维度等离子锻炉 (DTPF)
lines: 只在其他结构要求全部满足后检查这条限制。
更换成合格线圈后，重新检查结构即可清除错误。
各配方自身的温度要求仍然有效。
newMat: 海珀珍 或更高等级线圈
linesEn: The minimum is checked after all other structure requirements pass.
Install suitable coils and revalidate to clear the error.
Individual recipes retain their heat requirements.
summary: 线圈必须达到 海珀珍 或更高等级。
低级线圈会使完整结构无法成型。
summaryEn: Coils must be Hypogen or better.
A complete structure with lower coils is rejected.
entries.heading: 锻炉线圈门槛

entries.title: PCB工厂
lines: 涉及 12 条 超级湿件维生电路基板 和 9 条 超生物突变电路基板 配方。
替换流体的数量相同，板产量、耗时和电压不变。
电路组装机的基础板生产、化学反应釜的后续处理不需要因此增加铜等离子。
光学及更低级电路板不受这次替换影响。
newMat: 铜等离子（替代同量硫酸）
linesEn: Affected: 12 Wetware Extreme and 9 Bioware Ultra recipe variants.
The replacement uses the same mB amount; yield, duration and voltage are retained.
Base boards in Circuit Assembler and chemical finishing in reactors do not gain this requirement.
Optical and lower board tiers are unchanged.
newMatEn: Copper Plasma replacing the same amount of Sulfuric Acid
summary: 部分湿件和生物电路板：硫酸改为等量铜等离子。
这只影响 PCB工厂中的指定路线。
summaryEn: Selected Wetware and Bioware boards use Copper Plasma instead of Sulfuric Acid.
Only the specified PCB Factory routes change.
entries.heading: PCB工厂流体

entries.title: 化工厂
lines: 只修改化工厂路线，量子操纵者路线不变。
初始核能之星可在 4 A UHV 条件下制造。
newMat: 核能之星 ×8（替代重力之星）
linesEn: Only the Chemical Plant route changes; the QFT route is unchanged.
Output remains 40,320 mB, duration 800 seconds and power 3,842,160 EU/t.
The initial Nuclear Star can be produced at 4 A UHV.
summary: 突变活性焊料：8 个重力之星改为 8 个核能之星。
summaryEn: Mutated Living Solder uses 8 Nuclear Stars instead of 8 Gravistars.
entries.heading: 突变活性焊料

entries.title: 细菌培养缸
lines: 三种培养配方都增加这项材料。
流体产量放大时，这项粉末消耗不会跟着放大。
玻璃、培养物和辐射要求不变。
linesEn: All three Bacterial Vat variants gain this ingredient.
Native fluid amplification does not multiply the added dust cost.
Glass, culture and radiation requirements are retained.
newMatEn: 1 Radioactive Mineral Mix Dust per batch
summary: 生物培养基原液：每批额外消耗 1 份奇异粉。
summaryEn: Raw Bio Catalyst Medium adds 1 Radioactive Mineral Mix Dust per batch.
entries.heading: 生物培养基原液

entries.title: 臭氧净化单元
lines: 安全上限：原版 1,024,000 mB，ExtraNerf 改为 1,000,000 mB。
爆炸条件：开工时，臭氧输入仓的存量严格大于新上限；恰好等于上限不触发。
满仓风险：ZPM 仓可装 1,024,000 mB，原来安全，现在会超限。
最高档配方：臭氧用量改为 1,000,000 mB，基础成功率仍为 80%。
使用方式：开工前把仓内臭氧降到上限以内，不能直接装满 ZPM 仓。
linesEn: Safety limit: Originally 1,024,000 mB; ExtraNerf lowers it to 1,000,000 mB.
Explosion trigger: On starting, stored Ozone strictly exceeds the new limit. Exactly the limit does not trigger this rule.
Full hatch: A ZPM hatch holds 1,024,000 mB. A full hatch was safe under the original limit, but is now over the limit.
Highest recipe: Ozone input becomes 1,000,000 mB. Its base success chance remains 80%.
Operation: Reduce stored Ozone to the limit or below before starting; do not fill a ZPM hatch completely.
summary: 装满的 ZPM 仓会超限，开工时会爆炸。
summaryEn: Ozone safety limit: 1,024,000 → 1,000,000 mB.
A full ZPM hatch now exceeds the limit and causes an explosion on starting.
entries.heading: 臭氧净化单元削弱

entries.title: GT 单方块变压器/降压变换器
lines: 禁用范围：所有档位的普通、大电流、浸没式变压器及降压变换器。
电力接口：EU 输入和输出、无方向注入、能源广播、RF 输入均禁用。
原有存电：电量保留，但不能由这些设备输出。
不受影响：可调变压器、有源变压器（TecTech）、能量分配器（BartWorks）和 IC2 变压器。能量分配器只能同电压分配，不能升降压。
linesEn: Disabled devices: All tiers of normal, Hi-Amp and wet transformers, and buck converters.
Power interfaces: EU input/output, unsided injection, legacy energy interfaces and RF input are disabled.
Stored energy: Saved EU is retained, but cannot be emitted by these devices.
Unaffected: Manual Transformer, TecTech Active Transformer, BartWorks Energy Distributor and IC2 transformers. Energy Distributor keeps the same voltage; it cannot step voltage up or down.
summary: 这类单方块变压器已不能输入或输出电力。
仍可合成，并作为其他配方的材料。
summaryEn: These singleblock transformers can no longer receive or send power.
They can still be crafted and used as recipe ingredients.
entries.heading: 单方块变压器供电

entries.title: 蒸汽涡轮机
lines: HV 以上每升一档，效率增加 5 个百分点。
例如 EV 为 45%，IV 为 50%。
这里显示的是发电效率，不是产出数量倍率。
linesEn: Above HV, each tier adds 5 percentage points.
Examples: EV 45%, IV 50%.
These values are generation efficiencies, not output multipliers.
summary: 发电效率调整为：LV 20% / MV 30% / HV 40%。
summaryEn: Generation efficiency: LV 20% / MV 30% / HV 40%.
entries.heading: 蒸汽涡轮机效率

entries.title: 内燃发电机 (Diesel Generator)
lines: HV 以上每升一档，效率增加 5 个百分点。
例如 EV 为 45%，IV 为 50%。
这里显示的是发电效率，不是产出数量倍率。
linesEn: Above HV, each tier adds 5 percentage points.
Examples: EV 45%, IV 50%.
These values are generation efficiencies, not output multipliers.
summary: 发电效率调整为：LV 20% / MV 30% / HV 40%。
summaryEn: Generation efficiency: LV 20% / MV 30% / HV 40%.
entries.heading: 内燃发电机效率

entries.title: 燃气轮机 (Gas Turbine)
lines: HV 以上每升一档，效率增加 5 个百分点。
例如 EV 为 45%，IV 为 50%。
这里显示的是发电效率，不是产出数量倍率。
linesEn: Above HV, each tier adds 5 percentage points.
Examples: EV 45%, IV 50%.
These values are generation efficiencies, not output multipliers.
summary: 发电效率调整为：LV 20% / MV 30% / HV 40%。
summaryEn: Generation efficiency: LV 20% / MV 30% / HV 40%.
entries.heading: 燃气轮机效率

entries.title: 等离子发电机 (Plasma Generator)
lines: ZPM 为 45%，UV 为 50%。
等离子发电机从 EV 起算，不使用 LV 起步的效率表。
linesEn: ZPM efficiency is 45%; UV is 50%.
The Plasma Generator progression starts at EV, rather than using the LV table.
summary: 发电效率：EV 20% / IV 30% / LuV 40%。
summaryEn: Generation efficiency: EV 20% / IV 30% / LuV 40%.
entries.heading: 等离子发电机效率

entries.title: 半流质发电机 (Semi-Fluid Generator, GT++)
lines: HV 以上每升一档，效率增加 5 个百分点。
例如 EV 为 45%，IV 为 50%。
这里显示的是发电效率，不是产出数量倍率。
linesEn: Above HV, each tier adds 5 percentage points.
Examples: EV 45%, IV 50%.
These values are generation efficiencies, not output multipliers.
summary: 发电效率调整为：LV 20% / MV 30% / HV 40%。
summaryEn: Generation efficiency: LV 20% / MV 30% / HV 40%.
entries.heading: 半流质发电机效率

entries.title: 离心机 部分配方
lines: 钛铁矿渣：耗时 2→10 秒，新增 10% 概率的镓粉。
贫铀合金：480→7,680 EU/t，仍耗时 48 秒，产量不变。
黏液类材料和 红宝石汁 的离心回收配方已移除。
启用林业时，镨路线的铟副产物从 12 减至 8。
linesEn: Ilmenite Slag: duration 2→10 seconds, plus a 10% Gallium Dust output.
Staballoy: power 480→7,680 EU/t, still 48 seconds with the same yield.
Endstone: Tungstate chance 37.5%→10%; Helium output 4,320→1,500 mB.
Slime-family and Ruby Juice recovery recipes are removed.
With Forestry, the Praseodymium route gives 8 Indium Dust instead of 12.
summary: 钛铁矿渣处理变慢，末地石副产物减少。
贫铀合金分离的电压要求从 HV 提高到 IV。
summaryEn: Ilmenite Slag takes longer; Endstone yields fewer byproducts.
Staballoy separation now requires IV instead of HV.
entries.heading: 离心配方

entries.title: 电解机 部分配方
lines: 富集硅岩硫酸盐：每批增加 1,000 mB 二级净化水。
超能硅岩硫酸盐：每批增加 1,000 mB 三级净化水。
普通和多方块电解路线都适用，原金属产量不变。
newMat: 二级或三级净化水 1,000 mB / 批次
linesEn: Enriched Naquadah Sulphate adds 1,000 mB Grade 2 Water per batch.
Naquadria Sulphate adds 1,000 mB Grade 3 Water per batch.
Both electrolyzer maps are affected; metal yield is retained.
newMatEn: 1,000 mB Grade 2 or Grade 3 Water per batch
summary: 富集硅岩和超能硅岩的硫酸盐处理需净化水。
闪锌矿的镓粉概率从 9.17% 增至 10%。
summaryEn: Enriched Naquadah and Naquadria sulphate processing needs purified water.
Sphalerite Gallium chance rises from 9.17% to 10%.
entries.heading: 电解配方

entries.title: 搅拌机 部分配方
lines: Raw Tungstensteel必须经过 Industrial Brainrotter 才能成为成品钨钢。
钛铂钒合金粉的混合产量从 7 减至 3。
粗制中子素粉混合配方的氦等离子输入从 144 增至 1,440 mB。
linesEn: Refine Raw Tungstensteel in Industrial Brainrotter to obtain the finished material.
TPV Alloy Dust output falls from 7 to 3.
Raw Neutronium mixing uses 1,440 mB Helium Plasma instead of 144 mB.
summary: 钢和钨混合后得到Raw Tungstensteel粉，需要再精炼。
八条 红宝石汁 混合配方已移除。
summaryEn: Steel and Tungsten now mix into Raw Tungstensteel Dust that needs refining.
All eight Ruby Juice mixer recipes are removed.
entries.heading: 混合配方

entries.title: 砖高炉
lines: 保留 7 条炼钢配方，移除其余 39 条。
这条限制只影响产出钢的配方，其他砖高炉配方不变。
linesEn: Seven steelmaking recipes remain; the other 39 are removed.
Recipes that do not produce Steel are unaffected.
summary: 炼钢只能使用焦炭类燃料或 Railcraft 煤焦块。
summaryEn: Steelmaking accepts only Coke-family fuels or Railcraft Coal Coke Blocks.
entries.heading: 砖高炉燃料

entries.title: GT++ 真空干燥炉
lines: 闪锌矿原来分三格各产 64 铟粉，现在三格各产 32。
这些调整在启用林业时生效，其他金属和流体产量不变。
linesEn: Sphalerite has three output stacks: each falls from 64 to 32 Indium Dust.
These changes require Forestry. Other metal and fluid outputs are retained.
summary: 闪锌矿的铟产量：192 减至 96。
黄铜矿的铟产量：30 减至 20。
summaryEn: Sphalerite Indium output: 192→96.
Chalcopyrite Indium output: 30→20.
entries.heading: 真空炉铟产量

entries.title: 合成输入代理（Crafting Input Proxy）
lines: 被改的产物是合成输入代理，不能把这项要求套到太空组装模块自身的制造配方。
UQV 传感器与 UEV 传感器外观相同，但物品 ID 不同；不能用 UEV 传感器替代。
其余材料、流体、加工时间、电压和模块等级保留原要求。
linesEn: The affected product is the Crafting Input Proxy, not the Space Assembler Module itself.
UQV and UEV Sensors share an appearance but have different item IDs; a UEV Sensor cannot substitute.
Other ingredients, fluids, processing time, voltage and module tier are retained.
summary: 合成输入代理的太空组装配方用 1 个 UQV 传感器替代 1 个 UEV 传感器。
UQV 传感器在 NEI 搜索中隐藏，当前没有生产配方。
summaryEn: Crafting Input Proxy Space Assembler recipe uses 1 UQV Sensor instead of 1 UEV Sensor.
The UQV Sensor is hidden from NEI search and currently has no production recipe.
entries.heading: 合成输入代理传感器

entries.title: ME控制器
lines: 研究：用数据棒扫描 64k ME 存储元件，HV，60 秒。
请先取空存储元件，避免连同内部物品一起消耗。
制造：4 钛铂钒合金板、2 HV 电路、2 工程处理器、1 福鲁伊克斯块 和 576 mB 焊料。
装配线制造耗时 30 秒，电压为 LuV。
原工作台和 HV 组装机路线已移除。
linesEn: Research: scan a 64k ME Storage Cell onto a Data Stick, HV, 60 seconds.
Empty the cell first to avoid losing its stored items.
Production: 4 TPV Plates, 2 HV circuits, 2 Engineering Processors, 1 Fluix Block and 576 mB solder.
Assembly Line production runs at LuV for 30 seconds.
The crafting-table and old HV Assembler routes are removed.
summary: ME控制器改为在 LuV 装配线制造。
先扫描 64k 存储元件；元件和内部物品都会消耗。
summaryEn: ME Controller is now produced in a LuV Assembly Line.
Research consumes a 64k Storage Cell, including its contents.
entries.heading: ME控制器制造

entries.title: 空白样板
lines: 石英玻璃、赛特斯石英和铝材料不变。
newMat: 阳光化合物板 ×3（替代荧石板）
linesEn: Quartz Glass, Certus Quartz and Aluminium ingredients are retained.
summary: 空白样板：3 个荧石板改为 3 个 阳光化合物板。
summaryEn: Blank Pattern uses 3 Sunnarium Plates instead of 3 Glowstone Plates.
entries.heading: 空白样板材料

entries.title: 治愈之斧 => Hungry Axe
lines: 原来是回复饥饿值，现在改为扣除，最低扣到 0。
首次进入背包后会显示为Hungry Axe，放回箱子后仍保留名称。
用它攻击生物的行为不变。
linesEn: The former hunger restoration is reversed; hunger cannot fall below zero.
It becomes Hungry Axe on first entering an inventory and keeps that name in storage.
Attacking mobs is unchanged.
summary: 选中并手持这把斧子，每 2 秒会扣 1 点饥饿值。
summaryEn: While selected in your hotbar, this axe drains 1 hunger point every 2 seconds.
entries.heading: 手持斧子的饥饿消耗

entries.title: 燃料棒（荧石/阳光化合物）增殖削弱
lines: 脉冲数指完成增殖所需的累计次数，不是发电量。
linesEn: This is the cumulative pulse requirement to finish breeding, not an energy-output value.
summary: 荧石 / 阳光化合物 增殖燃料棒需要 1,000 次脉冲。
summaryEn: Glowstone / Sunnarium breeder rods require 1,000 pulses.
entries.heading: 增殖燃料棒脉冲

entries.title: 放射性燃料棒 (钍/铀/MOX)
lines: 每次运行的能量、热量和辐射不变，但燃料会更快耗尽。
乏燃料产物不变，锂燃料棒不受这条规则影响。
linesEn: Energy, heat and radiation per operation remain the same, but rods are depleted sooner.
Depleted outputs are retained. Lithium rods are unaffected.
summary: 钍、铀和 MOX 燃料棒寿命缩短为原来的 1/10。
summaryEn: Thorium, Uranium and MOX fuel-rod lifetime is reduced to one tenth.
entries.heading: 燃料棒寿命

entries.title: P2P通道
lines: 限制在 AE2 启用频道时生效，作用于隧道外部节点。
普通致密线缆仍可传输 32 个频道。
linesEn: The external-node limit applies when AE2 channels are enabled.
Ordinary Dense Cable still carries 32 channels.
summary: ME P2P通道最多传输 8 个频道。
多个输出端共享这 8 个频道，不是每端各 8 个。
summaryEn: ME P2P tunnels carry at most 8 channels.
Multiple outputs share those 8 channels; each output does not get its own 8.
entries.heading: P2P 频道上限

entries.title: 无线接入器/无线集线器 (AE2 Wireless)
lines: 每条连接的总耗电 = min(距离⁴, 10,000,000) EU/t，由两端各付一半。
距离按两个方块坐标的直线距离计算。
两个连接器中间隔一格墙时，距离为 2，总耗电为 16 EU/t。
每端每条连接最多耗电 5,000,000 EU/t。
集线器连接多条线路时，耗电相加；没有连接时不产生连接耗电。
linesEn: Total per-link draw = min(distance⁴, 10,000,000) EU/t, split equally between endpoints.
Distance is measured in a straight line between block coordinates.
A one-block wall between connectors gives distance 2 and costs 16 EU/t in total.
Each endpoint pays at most 5,000,000 EU/t per link.
Hubs add the cost of all links. An unconnected endpoint has no link power draw.
summary: 无线连接越远，耗电越高：总耗电按距离的四次方计算。
例如距离 32 格，总耗电为 1,048,576 EU/t。
summaryEn: Wireless link power grows with distance to the fourth power.
A 32-block link costs 1,048,576 EU/t in total.
entries.heading: 无线连接耗电

entries.title: 苯 / 苯酚 燃料值
lines: 这些是燃料值，不是发电机效率百分比。
linesEn: Benzene: 360→90.
Phenol: 288→72.
These are fuel values, not generator-efficiency percentages.
summary: 苯和苯酚的燃料值都降为原来的 1/4。
summaryEn: Benzene and Phenol fuel values are reduced to one quarter.
entries.heading: 燃料值

entries.title: 钨钢更名: TungTungTungstensteel
lines: 已有成品钨钢的物品身份不变，仍可正常用于配方。
搅拌机、量子操纵者和高炉等指定路线改产Raw Tungstensteel。
Raw Tungstensteel需经 Industrial Brainrotter 转为成品。
热Raw Tungstensteel锭必须先在真空冷冻机中冷却。
linesEn: Existing finished material keeps the same identity and remains usable in recipes.
Specified Mixer, QFT and EBF routes now yield Raw Tungstensteel.
Use Industrial Brainrotter to obtain finished material.
Cool hot raw ingots in a Vacuum Freezer before refining.
summary: 原成品钨钢更名为 TungTungTungstensteel。
新生产路线先得到Raw Tungstensteel，需要再精炼。
summaryEn: Finished Tungstensteel is renamed TungTungTungstensteel.
Production now yields raw material that requires refining.
entries.heading: 钨钢生产工序

entries.title: 量子之星
lines: 影响下界之星的化学浸洗路线，氡消耗为原来的 4 倍。
linesEn: The Nether Star Chemical Bath route uses 4x as much Radon.
summary: 量子之星的氡输入从 1,250 增至 5,000 mB。
summaryEn: Quantum Star Radon input rises from 1,250 to 5,000 mB.
entries.heading: 量子之星用料

entries.title: 黏液/史莱姆系产物
lines: 普通黏液球、匠魂粘液及史莱姆树叶的指定橡胶路线已移除。
黏性活塞需要 1 个粘合剂。
每个覆膜电路基板需要 2 个粘合剂。
每个电阻需要 2 个粘合剂。
原黏性树脂配方和流体胶水组装机配方仍可用。
linesEn: Specified Slimeball, TConstruct slime and Slimy Leaves rubber routes are removed.
Sticky Piston needs 1 Glue.
Each Coated Circuit Board needs 2 Glue.
Each Resistor needs 2 Glue.
Sticky Resin and the existing fluid-glue Assembler route remain available.
summary: 黏液球及指定匠魂材料的提取／离心路线已移除。
部分快捷合成改用 黏合剂（EMT）。
summaryEn: Slimeball and specified TConstruct extraction/centrifuging routes are removed.
Selected crafting shortcuts now use EMT Glue.
entries.heading: 粘液处理与粘合剂

entries.title: 机械方块/机器外壳 (ULV-UHV 档) 合成
lines: ULV 仍直接得到可用的机械方块。
LV–UXV 的工作台和组装机产物为生机械方块。
用手持凿子或工业凿子加工后，才能用于机器外壳和结构。
UEV–UXV 的原板材用量不变，只增加成品加工步骤。
linesEn: ULV still produces the finished casing directly.
LV–UXV crafting and Assembler routes yield raw casings.
Finish them with a hand Chisel or Industrial Chisel before using them in hulls or structures.
UEV–UXV keep their existing plate costs but also require finishing.
summary: ULV–UHV 机械方块使用 8 双重板。
LV 以上的生机械方块需凿子加工。
summaryEn: ULV–UHV casings use 8 Double Plates.
Raw casings from LV upward need Chisel finishing.
entries.heading: 机械方块加工

entries.title: 电阻 (Resistor) 合成
lines: 煤粉、碳粉、木炭粉和褐煤粉四种配方均适用。
原铜线和粉末仍需投入，不是用粘合剂替换它们。
linesEn: All four Coal, Carbon, Charcoal and Lignite variants are affected.
Copper wires and the original dust are still required; Glue is an additional ingredient.
summary: 每个电阻额外需要 2 个 黏合剂（EMT）。
summaryEn: Each Resistor needs 2 extra EMT Glue.
entries.heading: 电阻新增粘合剂

entries.title: GT 环 (Ring) 合成
lines: GregTech、BartWorks 和 Workstoff 的指定金属环配方同步调整。
linesEn: The specified GregTech, BartWorks and Workstoff ring recipes all change.
newMatEn: Long Rod of the same material
summary: 金属环合成改用同材质长杆，替代普通杆。
summaryEn: Ring crafting uses a Long Rod instead of a normal Rod of the same material.
entries.heading: 金属环用料

entries.title: 青铜粉
lines: 只影响这条无序工作台合成，不把其他青铜生产路线一并减产。
linesEn: Only this shapeless crafting route changes; other Bronze production routes are not reduced by this patch.
summary: 工作台混合 3 铜粉 + 1 锡粉，只得到 1 青铜粉。
原来同样材料可得到 3 青铜粉。
summaryEn: Crafting 3 Copper Dust + 1 Tin Dust now yields only 1 Bronze Dust.
The same ingredients previously yielded 3.
entries.heading: 青铜粉手工产量

entries.title: LV 电动马达 (LV Electric Motor)
lines: 工作台和组装机中的磁化铁 / 铁材料变体都已移除。
磁化钢 / 钢变体仍可制造，并可拆解。
linesEn: Both crafting and Assembler Iron Magnetic / Iron variants are removed.
Steel Magnetic / Steel variants remain available and are dismantleable.
summary: LV 马达的磁化铁配方已移除，改用磁化钢路线。
summaryEn: The magnetic-Iron LV Motor routes are removed; use the Steel variants.
entries.heading: LV 马达材料

entries.title: 优质电子电路板
lines: 仍可通过电路组装机生产。
酚醛树脂电路基板、二极管、铜线和焊料用量不变。
linesEn: Circuit Assembler production remains available.
Phenolic Circuit Board, Diodes, Copper Wire and solder quantities are retained.
summary: 优质电子电路板不能再工作台合成。
电路组装机中的基础电子电路板输入从 2 增至 4。
summaryEn: Good Electronic Circuit can no longer be hand-crafted.
Circuit Assembler Basic Electronic Circuit input rises from 2 to 4.
entries.heading: 优质电子电路板制造

entries.title: 高级电路板（IC2）
lines: 指 IC2 的高级电路，标准和 ASMD 两条电路组装机路线均适用。
其他材料、产出、耗时和电压不变。
linesEn: This is the IC2 Advanced Circuit. Both standard and ASMD Circuit Assembler routes are affected.
Other ingredients, output, duration and voltage are retained.
summary: 高级电路：逻辑IC 2→8，RAM芯片 2→8。
summaryEn: Advanced Circuit uses 8 ILC Chips and 8 RAM Chips instead of 2 each.
entries.heading: 高级电路板芯片用量（IC2）

entries.title: 纳米/量子处理器 (Nano/量子处理器)
lines: 影响标准和高级元件变体，共四条电路组装机配方。
例如原来 8 个变为 48 个，原来 12 或 16 个均变为 64 个。
SoC 路线和产出电路板的路线不受这条规则影响。
产出数量、耗时和电压不变。
linesEn: Four Circuit Assembler recipes change: standard and advanced-component variants of each processor.
Examples: 8→48, while both 12 and 16 become 64.
SoC routes and circuit-board outputs are exempt.
Output count, duration and voltage are retained.
summary: 纳米和量子处理器：消耗物品的用量 ×6。
每格最多 64 个；流体和不消耗的材料不变。
summaryEn: Nano and Quantum Processor consumable item inputs are multiplied by 6.
Each slot is capped at 64; fluids and non-consumables are unchanged.
entries.heading: 纳米与量子处理器用量

entries.title: 主机
lines: 原焊料标准和 ASMD 路线已替换。
标准路线：2 铝框、2 工作站、12 线圈、24 电容、16 RAM芯片、24 根 1 倍退火铜线。
ASMD 路线：2 铝框、2 工作站、3 ASMD 电感、4 ASMD 电容、16 RAM芯片、16 根 1 倍退火铜线。
两条路线都是 HV，每批产出 1 个；标准耗时 80 秒，ASMD 耗时 40 秒。
linesEn: The old standard and ASMD solder routes are replaced.
Standard: 2 Aluminium Frames, 2 Data Circuits, 12 Coils, 24 Capacitors, 16 RAM Chips and 24 single Annealed Copper Wires.
ASMD: 2 Aluminium Frames, 2 Data Circuits, 3 ASMD Inductors, 4 ASMD Capacitors, 16 RAM Chips and 16 single Annealed Copper Wires.
Both run at HV and yield one circuit. Standard takes 80 seconds; ASMD takes 40.
summary: 主机改为无尘室生产，每批需要 100 mB 灵魂灌注溶剂。
summaryEn: Elite Circuit production needs a cleanroom and 100 mB Soul Infused Medium.
entries.heading: 主机无尘室要求

entries.title: 白铜线圈方块 (白铜 Coils) 合成
lines: 硅酸铝粉路线：12→24。
绝缘云母箔路线：8→16。
这里的 2 倍线和 8 倍线指线材粗细，根数仍为 8。
linesEn: Alumino Silicate Wool variant: 12→24.
Mica Insulator Foil variant: 8→16.
Double and octal describe wire thickness; the count remains 8.
summary: 白铜线圈：8 根 2 倍线改为 8 根 8 倍线。
两种绝缘材料的用量都翻倍。
summaryEn: Cupronickel Coils use 8 octal wires instead of 8 double wires.
Insulation quantities double in both variants.
entries.heading: 白铜线圈用料

entries.title: MV 能源仓 (MV Energy Hatch)
lines: 原工作台配方已移除，因为网格放不下增加的芯片。
铜电缆、MV 泵、外壳、线圈和润滑油等其他材料不变。
linesEn: The crafting grid had no room for the added chips, so that route is removed.
Copper cable, MV Pump, hull, coils, Lubricant and other ingredients are retained.
summary: MV 能源仓只能用组装机制造。
超低功率IC输入从 2 增至 4。
summaryEn: MV Energy Hatch must be made in the Assembler.
ULPIC Chip input rises from 2 to 4.
entries.heading: MV 能源仓制造

entries.title: 超导线圈外壳 (Superconductor Coil Casing)
lines: LuV：64 根 2 倍线改为 64 根 8 倍线，绝缘云母箔 48→192。
ZPM：32 根 2 倍线改为 32 根 4 倍线，硅岩通用绝缘箔 4→8。
倍数指线材粗细，根数不变。更高档路线不变。
linesEn: LuV: 64 double wires become 64 octal wires; Mica Insulator Foil 48→192.
ZPM: 32 double wires become 32 quadruple wires; Naquarite Insulator Foil 4→8.
Thickness changes, not wire count. Higher-tier variants are unchanged.
summary: 超导线圈外壳的 LuV / ZPM 路线增加线材和绝缘用量。
summaryEn: LuV and ZPM Superconductor Coil Casing routes use thicker wire and more insulation.
entries.heading: 超导线圈用料

entries.title: 高阶外壳绝缘 (UV/UHV/UEV-UXV机器外壳)
lines: UV / UHV：组装机增加 288 mB 熔融凯芙拉，工作台增加 2 个凯芙拉板。
UEV / UIV / UMV：组装机增加 576 mB 熔融 Radox 聚合物，工作台增加 2 个双重板。
UXV：组装机同样增加 576 mB，工作台使用 2 个致密板。
回收外壳时不会返还新增绝缘材料。
UV 以下的外壳不受这条规则影响。
newMat: 凯芙拉或 Radox 聚合物绝缘材料
linesEn: UV / UHV: Assembler adds 288 mB Molten Kevlar; crafting adds 2 Kevlar Plates.
UEV / UIV / UMV: Assembler adds 576 mB Molten Radox Polymer; crafting adds 2 Double Plates.
UXV: the same 576 mB fluid cost, or 2 Dense Plates in crafting.
Hull recycling does not return the added insulation.
Hull tiers below UV are unaffected.
summary: UV 及以上机器外壳增加绝缘材料要求。
UV / UHV 用凯芙拉，更高档用 Radox 聚合物。
summaryEn: UV and higher Machine Hulls need additional insulation.
UV / UHV use Kevlar; higher tiers use Radox Polymer.
entries.heading: 高阶机器外壳绝缘

entries.heading: 钻石锯片齿轮

Neutronium Dust and other ingredients, plus output count, are retained.
summary: 粗制中子素粉混合：氦等离子从 144 增至 1,440 mB。

entries.heading: 粗制中子素粉用料

entries.title: GT 电缆组装机 (EV+ 绝缘)
lines: EV 及以上的全部粗细和绝缘材料变体，改用电缆涂覆机 / L.A.T.E.X.。
五类组装机绝缘配方增加 PPS箔，数量随绝缘材料用量变化。
不加 PPS 的 MV 材料：铁、镍、白铜、铜、退火铜。
不加 PPS 的 HV 材料：堪塔尔合金、金、金银合金、银、蓝合金。
工作台包线、打包机、合金炉和裸线制造不变。
linesEn: All EV+ cable widths and insulation variants now use Cable Coater / LATEX.
Five Assembler insulation families add PPS Foil, scaled with insulation amount.
MV exemptions: Iron, Nickel, Cupronickel, Copper and Annealed Copper.
HV exemptions: Kanthal, Gold, Electrum, Silver and Blue Alloy.
Hand wrapping, Packager, Alloy Smelter and bare-wire production are retained.
summary: EV 及以上电缆的组装机绝缘路线已移至 L.A.T.E.X.。
其余指定绝缘路线还需 PPS箔。
summaryEn: EV+ cable insulation moves from the Assembler to LATEX.
Other specified insulation recipes also require PPS Foil.
entries.heading: 电缆绝缘工序

entries.title: Industrial Brainrotter
lines: 机器为 5×5×3 结构，使用玻璃和防火原木，按 EV 运行。
热Raw Tungstensteel锭必须先用真空冷冻机冷却。
加工时保留底座上的Raw Tungstensteel锭，取走它会使该轮全部进度标记失效。
linesEn: The 5×5×3 structure uses glass and fireproof logs and runs at EV.
Cool hot raw ingots in a Vacuum Freezer first.
Keep the raw base ingot in place; removing it invalidates all progress markers for the cycle.
summary: 用于把冷却后的Raw Tungstensteel精炼成成品。
每锭需要 1 份木浆和不消耗的 Brainrot Compilation。
summaryEn: Refines cooled Raw Tungstensteel into finished material.
Needs 1 Wood Pulp per ingot and a non-consumed Brainrot compilation.
entries.heading: Raw Tungstensteel精炼

entries.title: 战利品袋 (Loot Bag) ME控制器掉落
lines: 涉及 AE2 Basic 和 AE2 Good 两种袋子。
没有保底获得机制，其他战利品奖励不变。
限制只针对这个袋子奖励，不限制自己制造的控制器。
linesEn: Applies to AE2 Basic and AE2 Good bags.
There is no guaranteed Controller reward. Other loot is retained.
The cap concerns this loot reward, not Controllers you craft.
summary: AE2 战利品袋的 ME控制器奖励从 4 台减为 1 台。
整个存档最多领取一次，不是每人一次。
summaryEn: AE2 loot-bag ME Controller rewards fall from 4 to 1.
Only one can be claimed per save, not one per player.
entries.heading: AE2 战利品奖励

entries.title: 二极管 (Diode) 组装机路线

每条原配方都含 4 根细铜线和配置电路 4。

Each also used 4 fine Copper Wires and configuration circuit 4.
Only these routes are removed; use another recipe still available in NEI.

summaryEn: Four LV Assembler routes for Diodes are removed.
entries.heading: 二极管移除路线

entries.title: 废土世界中的机器风险
lines: 适用维度：这两种物品开启的腐化之地（Toxic Everglades / 废土世界）。
触发条件：放置后即检查，不需要通电或开工。
影响设备：GT 蒸汽机器、发电机、仓和未成型控制器。
爆炸后果：移除机器。
不受影响：其他维度、普通结构方块、非 GT 机器及手动挖矿。
linesEn: Dimension: The Toxic Everglades reached through this portal frame and activated disk.
Trigger: Checked after placement; no power or active processing is required.
Devices: GT Steam machines, generators, hatches and unformed controllers.
Consequences: Machine removal.
Exempt: Other dimensions, ordinary structure blocks, non-GT machines and hand mining.
summary: 腐化之地中，放置 GT 机器会爆炸。
无需通电或开工；放置即触发。
summaryEn: GT machines placed in Toxic Everglades will explode.
No power or processing is needed; placement triggers the rule.
entries.heading: 废土世界机器风险
